title: Prove the control-OFF re-bind key depends on the flagged token's value, not just on being a re-bind
outcome: A test shows that source-root naming's flagged-token re-bind derives its idempotency key from the flagged token's value. In one fixture, two re-binds under different flagged tokens send different keys. A weaker fix, such as a constant re-bind salt, would therefore fail the tests.
acceptance: in one fixture, a re-bind under one flagged token and a later re-bind under a different flagged token send different idempotency keys, asserted by a test in src/tests/engram_source_root_off_rebind.rs
the change is reviewed and gated under the standing rule
